complete_original_PC_F081.title: Battle item reservation, consumption and cancellation failure prefix
complete_original_PC_F081.fact: pbRegisterItem writes UseItem,item,target,move into the choice before consuming from the bag. Only is_consumable? items are removed; player removal failure raises after choice writes, enemy removal deletes its owner-list occurrence. Returning an unused consumable adds to player bag only when capacity allows, otherwise raises; enemy owner items are pushed. pbCancelChoice returns any UseItem first, then unregisters Mega and clears choice. A refund failure therefore prevents later unregister/clear; there is no transactional rollback. pbItemUsesAllActions? is the PokeBall predicate.
